Task 1 Analysis — Click-by-Click

Excel / LibreOffice Calc / Google Sheets • Same steps for every project

← HomeData sheetReport builder

Step 0 — Open your data

  1. Download a starter: road • time • environment • health • business
  2. Open in Excel/Calc/Sheets → Save As GroupXX_Task1_Spreadsheet.xlsx.

Step 1 — Clean headings (5 min)

  • Row 1 bold, centre, freeze top row (View → Freeze).
  • No blank columns. Ratings/hours = numbers, not words.
  • Add borders. Create sheets: RawData, Analysis, Charts.

Step 2 — Copy-paste formulas (15 min)

Assume responses in rows 2–21. Type each in Analysis sheet:

WhatType thisExample result
Total respondents=COUNTA(RawData!A2:A21)20
Average (rating/hours)=AVERAGE(RawData!F2:F21)2.75
Maximum / Minimum=MAX(RawData!E2:E21) / =MIN(RawData!E2:E21)6 / 1
Count one answer=COUNTIF(RawData!D2:D21,"Bin")8
Percentage=COUNTIF(RawData!D2:D21,"Bin")/COUNTA(RawData!A2:A21)*10040%
Flag risky rows=IF(RawData!F2<=2,"Needs attention","OK") (copy down)—
Profit (business only)=C2*D2 total, =E2-F2 profit, =SUM(G2:G8) week—

Road safety swaps: =COUNTIF(D2:D21,"Walking"), =COUNTIF(J2:J21,"Always") phone-always.
Time swaps: =AVERAGE(C2:C21) study hrs, =AVERAGE(F2:F21) phone hrs, =COUNTIF(G2:G21,"Never") no timetable, =IF(F2>C2,"Phone>Study","Study≥Phone").

Step 3 — Chart in 6 clicks (10 min)

  1. On Analysis, make a mini table: Answer | Count (from your COUNTIFs).
  2. Select it → Insert → Column (bar) or Pie.
  3. Right-click chart → Add Data Labels; Chart Title: e.g. "Travel to school (n=20)".
  4. Move chart to Charts sheet. Must have: title + labels/legend.

Recommended per project: waste=bar waste types; road=bar travel mode + pie phone use; time=bar avg hours; environment=bar causes; health=pie handwash; business=line 7-day sales.

Step 4 — Validate (teacher checks this)

  • ☐ 20+ rows, headings, frozen top row?
  • ☐ 4+ different functions (SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/COUNTIF/MAX/MIN/IF)?
  • ☐ 1+ titled chart with labels?
  • ☐ File named GroupXX_Task1_Spreadsheet.xlsx?
  • ☐ One-sentence takeaway written under chart (reuse in report + slides)?
